
> toktickit-server@1.0.0 evidence
> tsx scripts/lab-02-evidence.ts

Requester A = Jennifer Anderson (id 1)
Requester B = Sarah Johnson (id 2)

----- 1. POST /api/tickets as Requester A (Ticket Number generated by the backend) -----
HTTP 201
{

----- 2. Same Ticket read straight from PostgreSQL (Prisma), not from the API -----
{
  "id": 161,
  "ticketNumber": "TKT-2026-000062",
  "requesterId": 1,

}
requesterId in the database (1) matches the selected Development Requester (1): true

----- 3. GET /api/tickets/:id as Requester B (owner is Requester A) -----
HTTP 404 {"error":"Ticket not found"}

----- 4. Upload an attachment as Requester A -----
HTTP 201
{
  "id": 105,
  "ticketId": 161,
  "originalName": "evidence.png",
  "mimeType": "image/png",
  "sizeBytes": 68,
  "uploadedAt": "2026-09-05T08:42:16.342Z",
  "removedAt": null,
  "removedReason": null,
  "removedById": null
}

----- 5. Download the active attachment as Requester A -----
HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, Content-Disposition attachment; filename="evidence.png"

----- 6. Download the same attachment as Requester B -----
HTTP 404 {"error":"Attachment not found"}

----- 7. Soft-remove the attachment as Requester A (reason required) -----
Without a reason: HTTP 400 {"error":"Removal reason must be 3-200 characters"}
With a reason: HTTP 200 {"id":105,"removedAt":"2026-09-05T08:42:16.400Z","removedReason":"Evidence run: wrong file uploaded"}

----- 8. Download the removed attachment again (soft removal blocks the file) -----
HTTP 410 {"error":"Attachment has been removed"}

----- 9. Removed attachment metadata is still stored in the database -----
{
  "id": 105,
  "originalName": "evidence.png",
  "mimeType": "image/png",
  "sizeBytes": 68,
  "uploadedAt": "2026-09-05T08:42:16.342Z",
  "removedAt": "2026-09-05T08:42:16.400Z",
  "removedReason": "Evidence run: wrong file uploaded",
  "removedById": 1
}

----- 10. Inactive Requester is never returned by the selector endpoint -----
Inactive requester in the database: Alex Turner (id 6)
GET /api/requesters returns ids: 3, 1, 5, 24, 2, 4
Inactive id present in the response: false
